SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CAA_ELEMENTS_UPDATE WHERE PRAC_ID = :B1 AND STATUS = 'NOT_PROCESSED'

SELECT PIN, ' ' TIER_NUMBER, AUTHORIZATIONTYPE AUTHORIZATION_TYPE , AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE EFFECTIVE_DATE , ENDDATE END_DATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC A WHERE PIN = :1 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE IN ('R', 'V') AND EFFECTIVEDATE = ( SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVEDATE) FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC B WHERE A.PIN=B.PIN AND A.AUTHORIZATIONTYPE = B.AUTHORIZATIONTYPE ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM( SELECT PIN, ' ' , AUTHORIZATIONTYPE, AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE, ENDDATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC A WHERE PIN = :2 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE IN ('P', 'D' , 'M') ORDER BY AUTHORIZATIONTYPE, NLSSORT(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 'NLS_SORT=WEST_EUROPEAN' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PIN , SUBSTR(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 2, 1) , AUTHORIZATIONTYPE , AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE , ENDDATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC WHERE PIN = :3 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE='G' ORDER BY SUBSTR(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 2, 1) , EFFECTIVEDATE DESC)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CAA_ELEMENTS_UPDATE WHERE PRAC_ID = :B2 AND PROV_ID =:B1 AND STATUS = 'NOT_PROCESSED'

SELECT DISTINCT A.PIN , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.NAME1)) NAME , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.NAME2)) NAME2 , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ADDRESSTYPE)) ADDRESS_TYPE , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ADDRESS1)) ADDRESS , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ADDRESS2)) ADDRESS2 , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ADDRESS3)) ADDRESS3 , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CITY)) CITY , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.STATE)) STATE , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ZIPCODE)) ZIP_CODE , RTRIM(LTRIM(A.TELNUMBER)) TEL_NUMBER FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCNAME_PRAC A WHERE A.PIN = :1 AND ADDRESSTYPE IN ('100', '010') ORDER BY ADDRESS_TYPE DESC

select distinct t.id, t.TIN, t.name from PORTICO.A_BCBSM_PDM_PROV a, pp_prov p, pp_prov_tin t, PP_PROV_TIN_PROV_CYCLE PPT where a.transaction_date > nvl((SELECT MAX(STOPPED) FROM pi_feedrun WHERE status = 'STOPPED' AND feed_id = 100998 ), '1jan1800') and a.prov_id = p.id and ppt.tin_id = t.id and PPT.PROV_ID=P.ID and TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(PPT.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(PPT.END_DATE) and ppt.tin_id not in (SELECT DISTINCT TIN_ID FROM PORTICO.PI_TIN_FEEDS WHERE SPECIAL_INSTR = 'EXCLUDE' and FEED_ID = 100998 and sysdate between start_date and end_date)order by t.id
